items.t: Record number of female candidates in 2026 midterms
items.x: The 2026 midterm elections are set to be historic, with more women on state and federal ballots this cycle and a record number running for the House of Representatives.

items.t: Fanfiction website AO3 could be down for 'up to four weeks'
items.x: The organization that runs Archive of Our Own, a massive fanfiction website, says the site might be down for up to four weeks.

items.t: Green Cove Springs 'digging in' to solve wild hog problem
items.x: The City of Green Cove Springs is bringing in trappers to help address an issue of yards dug up by wild hogs.

items.t: ‘They told me they weren't going to pay’: St. Augustine cleaner says she’s owed more than $2,400
items.x: Summer James says a payment dispute with a real estate company left her struggling to keep her small cleaning business afloat. She turned to Anthony Austin for help.

items.t: June Jones, whose run-and-shoot offense dazzled at Hawaii and in the NFL, dies at 73
items.x: June Jones, the trailblazing coach who brought the run-and-shoot offense to Hawaii and led the Rainbow Warriors to their greatest era and an undefeated regular season that catapulted them all the way to the Sugar Bowl, has died.

items.t: Binance reports 'potential security issue' as stablecoin issuers freeze millions in funds
items.x: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, is investigating a potential security issue that appears to be a hack.

items.t: Man convicted of shooting woman in the head after argument
items.x: A man is expected to spend two decades behind bars for shooting a woman in the head after a verbal argument in an apartment parking lot.

items.t: Getting you ready for the final week of the high school football regular season
items.x: High school football season is winding down. We will spotlight our top four games followed by our next best options. All games are 7 p.m. unless indicated. (Indicates Super 10 rankings).

items.t: 2026 midterms set new record for political ad spending
items.x: With less than a week until Election Day, midterm political ad spending and ad reservations have topped a record $11.21 billion.

items.t: Costco’s $200 Thanksgiving dinner feeds 8: Here's what's included
items.x: Costco is selling a ready-to-heat Thanksgiving dinner for eight people for $199.99, or about $25 per person.

items.t: 71-year-old grandmother missing after going on walk more than 3 weeks ago, police say
items.x: A 71-year-old New Jersey woman went for a walk more than three weeks ago and hasn’t been seen since.

items.t: Controversial attack ad featuring Democrat’s estranged mother has run its course in Ohio
items.x: Ohio Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy says his campaign is pulling its controversial attack ad featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Dr. Amy Acton.

items.t: Tributes pour in following 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart's death
items.x: Tributes are pouring in online for beloved actor Patrick Stewart, who died Wednesday at the age of 86.

items.t: Jacksonville working to better allocate gas tax money for bike, pedestrian safety
items.x: According to city code, 20% of the city's portion of the six-cent local option gas tax must go to bike and pedestrian safety projects.

items.t: Photo gallery: Scenes from high school soccer media day at the Riverside YMCA
items.x: Thursday was the fourth annual high school soccer media day at the Winston Family YMCA in Riverside hosted by Sporting JAX. Click through the images to check out soccer athletes from the area. The regular season begins on Nov. 2.

items.t: Increased 'security threat group' activity has 25+ state prisons and correctional facilities in Georgia on lockdown
items.x: The Georgia Department of Corrections says the facilities will "remain on lockdown until further notice" as assessments are ongoing.

items.t: 79-year-old man killed after collision with fire truck
items.x: A 79-year-old man was killed in a crash involving a fire truck.

items.t: MLB's 2027 season threatened with lockout looming when labor deal expires Dec. 1
items.x: Major League Baseball might face a long pause following the Milwaukee Brewers' first World Series title.

items.t: Builders Care builds 100th accessibility ramp of the year for Jacksonville family
items.x: Builders Care builds its 100th accessibility ramp of the year for an 89-year-old Jacksonville woman, helping her family safely get in and out of her longtime home.

items.t: Multiple myeloma: Cancer patient with 12 tumors finds hope as treatments advance
items.x: Kathy was so sick from multiple myeloma that she thought she was dying. Then a drug called Blenrep helped shrink her tumors. Various treatments now give hope.
